Natalie Masters appears in 29 recordings across 2 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1949 to 1956. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Natalie Masters most often in Fibber McGee and Molly and Candy Matson.

Characters credited here include Candy Matson.
